decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are closely related to the firm's established dental materials and laboratory workflow know-how, and the dedicated web presence suggests enough commitment and learning potential to continue.

A PETG thermoforming blank builds directly on the firm's existing expertise in dental materials and custom-device production, so its strong relatedness and own-page presentation make withdrawal unlikely.

UV-curing lacquer is still related to the firm's materials capabilities, but it is a somewhat narrower adjunct product and was only briefly mentioned on the website, which raises the chance of discontinuation somewhat.

Intraoral contrast spray fits the firm's digital dental workflow orientation and customer base, and the standalone presentation indicates it is important enough to keep while the firm learns from the market.
Custom earmolds are highly consistent with the firm's core custom-manufacturing and hearing-care activities, so its absorptive capacity in this area supports retention despite limited web prominence.
Custom hearing protection earmolds are closely connected to the firm's earmold and hearing-care knowledge base, making them commercially understandable and improvable enough to remain on the market.
